Class BenchmarkRisk

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reportviews.performance.BenchmarkRisk
public final class BenchmarkRisk extends Object
Relative risk of a portfolio against its benchmark. A pure function of its inputs, fixed by hand-calculated tests.

The risk sample I holds the common intervals of the comparison that are regular and in which both legs of the benchmark, the price and the exchange rate, were observed on both ends of the interval; a carried value is no observation. With r_i the interval return of the portfolio, q_i = b_i / b_(i-1) - 1 that of the benchmark and a_i = r_i - q_i the active return, all deviations are sample deviations: 

tracking error      = 100 * sqrt(252) * sd(a)
information ratio   = sqrt(252) * mean(a) / sd(a)
beta                = cov(r, q) / var(q)
correlation         = cov(r, q) / (sd(r) * sd(q))
Jensen's alpha      = 100 * 252 * alpha of the least-squares fit r_i - f_i = alpha + beta' * (q_i - f_i)
up / down capture   = 100 * G(r, S) / G(q, S), S the intervals with q_i > 0 / q_i < 0,
                      G(x, S) = (product over S of (1 + x_i))^(1/|S|) - 1

f_i = (1 + R)^(days/365) - 1 is the risk-free return of the interval, with R the annual rate known on its first day. Tracking error and information ratio use the same sample, so a jump on an excluded interval changes neither of them, while it still enters the linked returns of the comparison.

  • Method Details

    • calculate

      public static BenchmarkRisk.Result calculate(ReturnSeries portfolio, BenchmarkSeries.Result benchmark, IntPredicate common, Function<LocalDate, Double> annualRate)
      Calculates the risk figures.
      Parameters:
      portfolio - the time-weighted series of the portfolio
      benchmark - the benchmark aligned on the same valuation dates, with a span
      common - whether the interval ending at an index is a common interval of the comparison
      annualRate - the annual risk-free rate as a decimal known on a date, null when unknown; the function itself may be null when no rate is available at all
      Returns:
      the figures, a figure that cannot be determined is null
